info.title: An EgG
info.author: Daniel Barros (LF)
info.description: a stupid game about stupid eggs
info.details:
explore a stupid, vibe-coded desk filled with eggs. this desk makes no sense, like, why does a desk have caves and can be infiltrated by UNDEF!? (who, by the way, is NOT a real glitch. ...well, in lore it is BUT NOT IN THE CODING)

explore many biomes. scare eggs away because you fried their friends, give UNDEF meat to make him very, VERY hyperactive and memey, and do insane things to giraffes.

AI use: AI-generated, not reviewed line by line. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
